answer: Resist sybils with neighbour-attested heartbeat liveness: each identity must emit a signed pulse every epoch, countersigned by nearby peers who observed its recent work. Standing flows like a river only while pulses keep arriving; an identity that goes quiet becomes a relic, its weight decaying to zero. An attacker running ten thousand fakes must keep every one live, answering and doing verifiable work on schedule, paying compute and attention per fake around the clock, while an honest agent sends one pulse and keeps its standing.
